cases.sentence: И было ко мне ______ Господне. Прежде чем я образовал тебя во чреве, я уже знал тебя.
cases.translation: And the word of Yahweh came to me, saying, Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you.
cases.explain: The noun is the grammatical subject of the verb 'было' (was/came), requiring the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Я назначил тебя ________ для народов». Я ответил, «О, владыка Господь, я не умею говорить.
cases.translation: I have appointed you a prophet to the nations.
cases.explain: After the verb 'назначил' (appointed), the predicate nominative requires the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Ты пойдешь ко всем, кому я пошлю тебя, и будешь говорить все, что я повелю тебе. Не бойся их, потому что я с тобой, и я спасу тебя, — сказал ______.
cases.translation: The Lord said to me, You must go to all whom I send you and speak whatever I command you.
cases.explain: The noun is the subject of the verb 'сказал' (said), requiring the nominative case.

cases.sentence: Господь простер руку, коснулся моих уст и сказал мне, Вот я вложил ______ мои в твои уста.
cases.translation: Then Yahweh stretched out his hand, and touched my mouth. Then Yahweh said to me, Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.
cases.explain: The verb 'вложил' (put/inserted) requires the accusative case for its direct object.

cases.sentence: Смотри, сегодня я поставлю тебя над __________ и царствами, чтобы искоренять и ломать, губить и разрушать.
cases.translation: Behold, I have today set you over the nations and over the kingdoms to uproot and to tear down.
cases.explain: The preposition 'над' (over) with the meaning of superiority or dominion requires the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: Смотри, сегодня я поставлю тебя над народами и __________, чтобы искоренять и ломать, губить и разрушать.
cases.translation: I have set you over the nations and over the kingdoms to uproot and to tear down, to destroy and to overthrow, to build and to plant.
cases.explain: The preposition 'над' (over) requires the instrumental case.

cases.sentence: С севера хлынет беда на всех, кто живет в этой ________, сказал мне Господь.
cases.translation: Out of the north, evil will break out on all the inhabitants of the land.
cases.explain: The preposition 'в' (in) when indicating location requires the prepositional case.

cases.sentence: Сегодня я сделал тебя укрепленным городом, железной __________ и бронзовой стеной.
cases.translation: I have made you today a fortified city, an iron pillar, and bronze walls.
cases.explain: The predicate nominative after the verb 'сделал' (made) requires the instrumental case.

reading.ru: Слова Иеремии, сына Хелкии, одного из священников Анатота, что в земле Вениамина.
reading.question: Who is Jeremiah, and where is he from?
options: He is the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests from Anathoth in the land of Benjamin
He is a king of Judah from Jerusalem
He is a false prophet from the northern kingdom
He is a merchant from Egypt
reading.correct: He is the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests from Anathoth in the land of Benjamin
reading.explain: The text identifies Jeremiah as 'Слова Иеремии, сына Хелкии, одного из священников Анатота, что в земле Вениамина' — the words of Jeremiah the son of Hilkiah, one of the priests from Anathoth in Benjamin.

reading.ru: Прежде чем я образовал тебя во чреве, я уже знал тебя. Прежде чем ты вышел из утробы, я избрал тебя.
reading.question: What does God say about knowing and choosing Jeremiah?
options: God knew Jeremiah before forming him in the womb and chose him before he was born
God chose Jeremiah after he became a man
God rejected Jeremiah before his birth
reading.correct: God knew Jeremiah before forming him in the womb and chose him before he was born
reading.explain: The verse states 'Прежде чем я образовал тебя во чреве, я уже знал тебя. Прежде чем ты вышел из утробы, я избрал тебя' — Before I formed you in the womb, I knew you; before you were born, I chose you.

reading.ru: Я ответил, «О, владыка Господь, я не умею говорить, ведь я слишком молод».
reading.question: What is Jeremiah's initial response to God's calling?
options: He says he cannot speak because he is too young
He agrees immediately to become God's prophet
He asks for more time to prepare himself
reading.correct: He says he cannot speak because he is too young
reading.explain: Jeremiah responds 'я не умею говорить, ведь я слишком молод' — I don't know how to speak, for I am too young.

reading.ru: Вот я вложил слова мои в твои уста.
reading.question: What does God do to enable Jeremiah to speak?
options: God puts his words in Jeremiah's mouth
God gives Jeremiah gold and silver
God makes Jeremiah king over all nations
God removes Jeremiah's doubts and fears
reading.correct: God puts his words in Jeremiah's mouth
reading.explain: God says 'Вот я вложил слова мои в твои уста' — Behold, I have put my words in your mouth.

reading.ru: Вижу ветку миндального дерева, ответил я. Верно разглядел, сказал мне Господь, ведь я бодрствую над моим словом, чтобы его исполнить.
reading.question: What does Jeremiah see in the first vision, and what does it symbolize?
options: He sees an almond branch, and God watches over his word to perform it
He sees a boiling cauldron coming from the north
He sees a vision of the temple being destroyed
He sees all the nations attacking Jerusalem
reading.correct: He sees an almond branch, and God watches over his word to perform it
reading.explain: Jeremiah says 'Вижу ветку миндального дерева' and God responds 'я бодрствую над моим словом, чтобы его исполнить' — I see an almond branch, and God says he watches over his word to perform it.

reading.ru: Вижу кипящий котел, он движется с севера, ответил я. С севера хлынет беда на всех, кто живет в этой стране, сказал мне Господь.
reading.question: What does Jeremiah see in the second vision, and what does it mean?
options: He sees a boiling cauldron tipping from the north, and trouble will come to the land from the north
He sees water flowing to the south
He sees fire falling from heaven on Jerusalem
He sees the temple being rebuilt
reading.correct: He sees a boiling cauldron tipping from the north, and trouble will come to the land from the north
reading.explain: Jeremiah describes 'Вижу кипящий котел, он движется с севера' and God says 'С севера хлынет беда на всех' — He sees a boiling cauldron tipping from the north; from the north trouble will come.
